notes.title: Minor Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]A few little updates based on feedback![/b]

- Implemented a fix for player being able to get stuck behind certain burnable brambles when loading into certain spots.

- Added extra dialogue to region Elders to improve player direction when they have collected enough Stuff.

- Added some extra dialogue to a certain Forest Villager NPC.

- Fixed a spot in the Mountains where player could get stuck.

- Extended respawn duration of certain breakable pots involved in a puzzle.

- Corrected some anchoring issues on the Credits screen causing issues at certain resolutions.

notes.title: Another Quick Fix
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue where new games were failing to correctly reset collectable tracking data

notes.title: Quick Post Launch Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]A handful of minor bugs slipped through the cracks, but hopefully we've managed to address them before they impact anyone![/b]

- Fixed a bug preventing the Art Critic side objective from being completable
- Fixed an issue causing incorrect collectable tracking counts in the Archipelago
- Fixed an issue preventing a particular crystal in the Archipelago from being collectable
- Fixed a minor navigation issue with the tutorial AI
